findings.claim: A configured but wrong OverlayDir could reach the not-found return and be reported as benign. Refuted: locateOverlay returns early for any non-empty configured value (absolute: the root; relative: an error), so overlayNotFoundError only comes from the upward search with nothing configured (opencode_contracts.go:85-90).
evidence: series review of b88fbec6 (two judges); read of locateOverlay.
